    • Meet our experts

    AXA Research: Navigating Change, Shaping Insight

    Gilles Moëc

    Chief Economist of AXA Group

    Our Research department brings together two expert teams — Macroeconomic Research and Environment & Resilience Research — united by a shared mission: to inform decisions, anticipate risks, and support sustainable value creation. 

    The Macroeconomic Research team delivers in-depth analysis of global markets and economic trends, offering strategic insights that guide investment decisions and risk assessments. Through timely forecasts and structural evaluations, we help our company and clients stay ahead in a dynamic world.

    The Environment & Resilience Research team explores the profound implications of climate change, the energy transition, and systemic environmental and social risks. By identifying long-term trends and fostering collaboration with clients, academia, and internal teams, we contribute to building adaptive, forward-looking strategies that combine environmental integrity with social impact.

    Together, we provide an integrated view of today’s challenges — economic, environmental and social — grounded in science, enriched by partnership, and committed to progress.
